# TPC-DS-OBT Q6

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT bill_addr_ca_state AS state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (bill_addr_ca_address_sk = bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk AND bill_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk AND obt.sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.item_sk = item_i_item_sk AND sold_date_d_month_seq = (SELECT DISTINCT (obt.sold_date_d_month_seq) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998 AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 1) AND channel = 'store') AND item_i_current_price > 1.2 * (SELECT AVG(item_i_current_price) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE item_i_category = obt.item_i_category AND channel = 'store')) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY bill_addr_ca_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY cnt, bill_addr_ca_state LIMIT 100
```
